decision: ACCEPT Peerit release sequence 26 as the LIVE bounded-public-test launch successor: a copy-and-affordance UX-honesty release — first-visit boot-time indication (cold start is about a minute, instant after), a 'read more' affordance on truncated feed excerpts, and composer local-only honesty — riding the seq-25 first-visit liveness posture with ZERO verification, transport, or logic changes beyond the listed copy. authority.owner_instruction: Three copy/UX items, no logic. (A) First-time visitors stare at a blank boot during the ~60-100s cold recovery with no indication why — tell them the cold start takes about a minute (boot splash + the home empty state they see while the 39-record seed materializes). (B) Feed excerpts truncate at 360 chars with a bare ellipsis and feel cut off — lengthen to 700 and add an explicit 'read more' link on truncation. (C) A browser comment does not sync cross-machine; that is the DISCLOSED boundary (browser writes are roadmap T2, relays accept no public CELL.PUT) — say so honestly in the composer instead of implying it syncs. Zero verification, transport, or logic changes beyond this copy.

root_cause.mechanism: UX-honesty only, no defect. (A) A cold first visit spends ~60-100s verifying two signed relay chains and the 39-record launch seed from scratch; the boot splash ('connecting to peers') and the home empty state gave no indication, so first-time visitors read it as hung. (B) Feed post excerpts truncated at body.slice(0, 360) with a bare ellipsis, feeling cut off. (C) The comment composer invited 'Write a signed comment' without disclosing that browser-authored records are stored on this device only (no public CELL.PUT authority exists; ordinary delivery is local-only; cross-device sync is roadmap track 2).
